subject: Candidate missed slot — childcare emergency; rescue plan and options
messages:

To: Ethan Zhang <ezhang@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Subject: Interview today 10:30am PST — quick check-in & proctor details

Hi Ethan —

Quick confirmation for our 10:30am PST interview today. Attached are the proctor instructions and the Zoom link below. Please join 5 minutes early so we can confirm audio/video and share the coding pad.

From: Ethan Zhang <ezhang@gmail.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-04T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interview today 10:30am PST — quick check-in & proctor details

Sofia — I am so sorry. My toddler just had a small accident at daycare and they called me to pick them up. I’m en route but daycare closed unexpectedly and my neighbor’s car battery died so I’m stuck without a ride. On top of that our building lost broadband (I can’t get a stable connection on mobile). I don’t want to waste your team’s time by showing up late and unreliable.

If possible, I can do an asynchronous option (record a 45min code walk I can screen-share or submit a short take-home right away). If you have any availability later today (late afternoon) I can try to accommodate. Otherwise, totally understand if we need to reschedule.

Really sorry for the last-minute notice — I value the slot and appreciate your understanding.

— Ethan
Cell: +1 (650) 555-3344
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Interview today — candidate issue (Ethan Zhang)

Forwarding Ethan’s note — he’s dealing with a childcare + broadband outage and asked about async or later today. Quick thoughts on rescue options: 

- Option A (immediate salvage): Call him now (15 min) for a behavioral + high-level system design phone screen to capture some signal. Then offer a recorded codewalk (we send recording template) that he can upload within 4 hours. Interviewers: Markus can do the design call; Irene can review the recorded walkthrough asynchronously.

- Option B (same-day condensed): Move the technical session to 3:00pm PST, compress to 45 minutes (system design + focused coding prompt). We can offer a childcare stipend (Uber/care credit — $75) to cover his costs today.

- Option C (reschedule): Reschedule to earliest mutually-available slot next week.

I recommend Option A right now (capture signal and keep candidate engaged) and offer Option B as a follow-up if he’s able to recover connectivity. I’ve attached the recording_offer_template.txt we use for cases like this. If you agree I’ll text him and set expectations.

Attachments: recording_offer_template.txt

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Zhang <ezhang@gmail.com>
Date: 2028-07-04T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interview today — candidate issue (Ethan Zhang) — plan confirmed

Thanks Marissa — and Ethan, thanks for the heads up and I’m sorry you’re dealing with that today.

Plan we’ll follow (Option A + B fallback):
1) Marissa, please call Ethan now and offer a 15-minute phone check-in to cover behavioral + system thinking. Suggest a window 10:30–11:00am if he can get to a stable spot; otherwise ask if he can submit a short recorded 20–30 minute coding walkthrough by 5pm today. Use the recording template (attached).
2) If he can recover connectivity, we’ll attempt a condensed 45-minute live loop at 15:00 PST with Markus (system design + focused coding). Irene will be the async reviewer if he records.
3) Approve childcare/transport stipend up to $75 if he needs immediate help today — Marissa can handle expense submission and a quick manual reimbursement via PayPal/Stripe.

Irene — please stand by to review an async recording if we receive it, and mark availability for a 15:00 remote slot in case Ethan reports he can join. Markus — please hold 15:00–15:50 PST if possible.

Marissa: can you send the candidate the recording_offer_template.txt and the Zoom/call details, and confirm whether he wants the stipend? If we don’t get a reply by 11:30am I’ll mark the slot as a no-show and ask recruiting to reschedule.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
